name: Flaw Sight
description: Look at a plank or a plate or a guard and see the line along which it will fail first.

name: Seamsplit Strike
description: Strike the exact seam that sight reveals so the whole piece cracks open along it.

name: Faultline Guard
description: Meet a blow on the forearm at the angle where it will spend itself and shatter against the arm.

name: Brittle Step
description: Step lightly on ground that crumbles after the foot has left it and spoils the pursuer's footing.

name: Hairline Flick
description: Flick a thread of breaking qi at a crack so that it runs the length of the piece.

name: Fracture Press
description: Press a thumb into the weak joint of a guard and fracture the stance behind it.

name: Splitgrain Palm
description: Strike a board or a stone slab with a palm that splits it from the point of contact.

name: Splinter Guard
description: Hold up a forearm that breaks a wooden club into splinters when it lands.

name: Rubble Step
description: Break the ground behind the heel as it lifts so the pursuer steps into loose stones.

name: Crumble Flick
description: Flick a bead of breaking qi at a thrown stone so it crumbles to grit in the air.

name: Shivering Grip
description: Grip the foe's shield rim and send a shiver of breaking through it until the hold fails.

name: Breaking Stance
description: Plant a wide stance that shatters the force of a shove into the ground without bending.

name: Snapping Strike
description: Strike a forearm at the bend and snap the strength of the limb at once.

name: Toppling Shove
description: Shove through the foe's balance at the hip and topple the stance as a whole.

name: Elbow Sunder
description: Drive a short elbow into a leaning guard and sunder the arm that holds it.

name: Collapse Step
description: Drop the weight and step through as the footing gives way beneath the foe.

name: Wreck Palm
description: Strike a gate-bar or a chest-lid with a palm that wrecks the latch inside.

name: Rend Block
description: Rend a thrown spear off its line with a forearm swept across its shaft.

name: Unmaking Touch
description: Touch one strap or knot or clasp and unmake that single piece of its hold.

name: Undo Grip
description: Take the foe's wrist and undo the clench of his fingers one by one.

name: Dissolving Palm
description: Strike a dried clay or lime surface with a palm that dissolves it to dust.

name: Loosening Guard
description: Take a hold on the guard arm and loosen its grip as it closes.

name: Unpicked Step
description: Step out of a grasp by unpicking the hold with a quick twist of the hips.

name: Loosening Flick
description: Flick a thread of unmaking qi at a rope knot from a pace away to loosen it.

name: Unravel Touch
description: Touch the gathering qi of a foe's first move and unravel it before it forms.

name: Seam Sense
description: Sense the joins in a wall or a lock or a gear and learn which will give first.
